value.title: The pij shim forwards community verbs to pij-rs
value.summary: The pij shim execs pij-rs for the verbs pij-rs owns help for, and for role and --to sends, before tsx loads; one list, one contract test, latency receipts.

value.title: Shim fast path: community verbs and role sends exec pij-rs unchanged
value.success: harness/scripts/pij-cli.cjs execs pij-rs for every verb in harness/scripts/pij-native-verbs.json and for send to role:, with --to or --help, with argv, stdin, output and exit code unchanged; everything else and any non-rs generation keeps the routed path; the TS route table marks the same verbs nativeCommand.

value.title: pij-rs send takes the shim's positional form; help is pij-rs's
value.success: pij-rs send accepts send <recipient> [<text>] as well as --to/--body (mutually exclusive), and its help shows role sends, --reply and --fyi; pij <verb> --help prints pij-rs's help for every forwarded verb.

value.title: One contract test from clap, with negative controls
value.success: The shim's verb list equals clap's subcommands that own their help; a new unlisted verb and a stale listed verb each fail the check; calls outside the contract (a seat send, a paneless role send, a flag value that looks like a role, a non-rs generation, an unowned verb) never reach pij-rs.

value.title: Latency before and after (F44)
value.success: Per-call latency of the shim against native pij-rs, before and after, interleaved under the same load, with the load noted.

value.title: Docs, cost and states
value.success: docs/how/pij-rs-api.md has the shim forwarding section and exit row; SKILL.md says the shim forwards; F30, F42, F43 and F44 name plan 213; the PR body has Delivers: none; no workstream state changes; no new launch site, timer or poll.

tk-0001.assertion: Through the shim, every listed verb and every flag its pij-rs help names reaches a recording pij-rs with argv and stdin unchanged, and the shim prints its output and exit code (crates/cli/tests/shim_forward.rs, CI).

tk-0002.assertion: shim_forward_tests::send_takes_the_shims_positional_form passes, and help through the shim is byte-equal to pij-rs help for every forwarded verb and send (CI).

tk-0003.assertion: shim_forward_tests::the_shim_forwards_exactly_the_verbs_that_own_their_help and shim_forward::calls_outside_the_contract_keep_the_routed_path pass, each with its negative controls (CI).

tk-0005.assertion: just ddocs-check passes; spawn_sites unchanged (no daemon launch site added); CI green on the exact head; reviewer, security and performance verdicts.
